Incremental policy ruleset chunk from file '04_agentic_guardrails.md' (1-based global rule indices 61–70).

Rules in this chunk:
61. A call to freeze a card requires that the card has status ACTIVE.
62. A call to unfreeze a card requires that the card exists and has status FROZEN.
63. A call to unfreeze a card is not permitted if the affected account has any active restriction of type FRAUD_HOLD.
64. A call to unfreeze a card is not permitted if the affected account has any active restriction of type AML_REVIEW.
65. A call to unfreeze a card is not permitted if the affected account has any active restriction of type SANCTIONS_BLOCK.
66. A call to unfreeze a card is not permitted if the affected account has any active restriction of type COURT_ORDER.
67. A call to apply an account restriction requires that the account exists.
68. A call to apply an account restriction of type AML_REVIEW requires human approval.
69. A call to apply an account restriction of type SANCTIONS_BLOCK requires human approval.
70. A call to apply an account restriction of type COURT_ORDER requires human approval.
